name: vscode-sfc-previewer
description: VS Code extension that allows previewing React, Svelte, and Vue Single File Components (SFC).

scripts.bundle: esbuild extension.js --bundle --outfile=dist/extension.js --external:vscode --external:./jsx-render.js --external:./svelte-render.js --external:./vue-render.js --format=cjs --platform=node && esbuild jsx-render.js svelte-render.js vue-render.js --bundle --outdir=dist --external:vscode --format=cjs --platform=node
scripts.build: npm run bundle && npx vsce package
